_: The registry of every person in the house, read through v2/scripts/lib/registry.mjs (T-641). Each lane is one record. PERSON: `id` (the permanent lane key, identical to the key), `name` (display name, unique across the file), `title` (job title), `icon` (🧠, 🔧 or 🤖). DESK: `folder` (relative to v2/, never shared with another lane: its PICKUP.md is the only one it may write, scripts/lib/pickup-owner.mjs, Herdr.md D4) and, for a sidekick lane, `owner` (the lane of the desk that dispatches to it). A sidekick lane is one whose engine is cursor, agy, grok or openrouter and whose folder sits below a desk; it lives under desks/<owner's department>/sidekicks/, so build's are desks/build/sidekicks/ although Tyrion's own folder is desks/build/tyrion, and scripts/check-sidekick-owners.mjs enforces it (T-684). CHAIR: `engine` (claude, agy, cursor, opencode, grok or openrouter), `model` (null for grok, whose TUI has no model selector, and openrouter, whose model openrouter-rotation.mjs picks per job) and an optional `host` (a lane with a host runs on that machine, T-267). No pane id is stored: herdr pane ids are positional and change on every rebuild, so registry.mjs resolves them live through findDeskPane() in scripts/lib/desk-pane.mjs. `seats.primary`/`seats.sidekick` (T-360, seats.mjs) name which lane sits in the desk window's third column and which sits in the sidekicks window; kept on one line so a swap is a one-line diff. `aliases` lists other names the desk goes by, so a note signed with one is still recognised as its own. A lane with `engine: agy` runs the Gemini CLI, not Claude, so the launcher tags its pane but starts a plain shell (T-360). PURPOSE (every lane): one plain sentence saying what the lane is for; where it runs is already in engine, model and host. TOOLBOX (every desk, not sidekicks): an array of the desk's top three skills as invocation names, `slopdog:<name>` for a plugin skill and the bare name for a tasks-tree or desk-local skill; it must name real SKILL.md files, and an empty array is allowed only for a scripted lane with no skills (scribe). The Claude Code footer drawer mod (~/.claude/mods/suppress-questions) reads this file at runtime and shows the current desk's toolbox first, so adding a tool is a one-line edit here.
